zh: 答案只和数值的大小关系有关，与原数组的位置无关：本质是在同一个多重集合里，用一个元素去严格压过另一个元素，数一数最多能配成多少对。
把数组排序后贪心：让每个元素去压当前还没被压过的最小元素。用最小的可行对象配对，不会浪费更大的元素。
排序数组 a，指针 i 指向尚未被压过的最小元素，初始为 0；从小到大遍历每个元素 z，若 z 严格大于 a[i]，配对数加一并让 i 右移；遍历结束后 i 就是最大的位置数，输出它。
en: The answer depends only on the relative order of values, not on positions in the original array: within one multiset, each element may strictly beat another one, and you want the maximum number of such pairs.
Sort the array and match greedily: let each element beat the smallest element that has not been beaten yet. Using the smallest feasible target never wastes a larger element.

Sort the array a and keep a pointer i, starting at 0, to the smallest element not yet beaten. Go through every element z in ascending order; if z is strictly greater than a[i], count a match and move i right. After the loop, i is the maximum number of positions; print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the array and greedily match each element with the smallest feasible strictly smaller element.

## Proof of correctness

Matching with the smallest feasible element never wastes a larger element, so the greedy maximizes the number of matched pairs.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time, O(n) space.
